format.comment: #286 G7: relaxed from a hardcoded enum to any non-empty string — the inspector's SourceProfile.format is the authority (same relaxation #74 made for labels at 'confidence'/label). The old list even omitted xlsx/pdf/ndjson; new inspectors (biom, vcf, …) register formats additively.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of source bytes, sealed at `mapforge map` time. Used by `mapforge submit` to populate Contribution.source_sha256 without re-opening the source file. Optional for back-compat with pre-E5 bundles.

license.description: Free-form. SPDX identifier (e.g. CC-BY-4.0, MIT, Apache-2.0) strongly recommended but not enforced — keeps the bar low for customers who don't know SPDX conventions.

url.description: Canonical source URL (homepage, download page, or DOI redirect). RFC 3986. Format-checked at validation time.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier of the source dataset. Bare DOI (no `doi:` prefix, no URL). Pattern: `10.<registrant>/<suffix>`.

contact.description: Email address of a person or alias responsible for source-level questions. RFC 5321. Format-checked at validation time.

version.description: Free-form source version string (e.g. `v89`, `2024-Q4`, `snapshot-2026-06-01`). Distinct from MapForge's own bundle version.

accessed_at.description: ISO 8601 date `YYYY-MM-DD` when this source snapshot was retrieved. No time / timezone — calendar day only. Pattern enforces shape only, not calendar validity — values like `2026-99-99` would pass but are obviously wrong; authors are expected to use real dates.

ethics_ref.description: Free-form ethics/IRB reference (e.g. `IRB-2024-0428`). Customer-local; not validated against any registry.

ref_column.description: Optional. When present, names a column whose per-row value is copied into IRNode/IREdge.provenance.ref by the tabular path (3b-2 / #126). Omitted rows produce no provenance.ref.

label.comment: A1' slice 4 (#74): relaxed from a hardcoded enum to any non-empty string. The project's schema_config is now the authority for allowed labels (mapper filters before validation via _allowed_labels(schema_config)).
